description: Published status page + process-metrics view. A derived view from Compose state only (journal, judgment ledger, gate log, sessions, feature.json): a static one-file HTML snapshot (`compose status export [--project|--all]` plus a cockpit "Publish snapshot" button), a process-metrics panel (per-unit time split authoring/review/fix/waiting/gate, first-pass CLEAN rate, review rounds per unit, gate minutes per land, waiting share), a master rollup across workspaces, and an "owner owes" list. Replaces the hand-kept per-project status builders in SmartMemory scratch. Sibling of COMP-COCKPIT-12 (live session view). Open: does the export embed data or link live.
phase: COMP-COCKPIT Wave 2: UX Journey Gaps (2026-06-10 sweep)
